rules_changed.rule: chi-square probes along every principal axis AND every pairwise diagonal (2p^2); a converged refit with a lower objective inside the separation radius refuses NOT_A_LOCAL_MINIMUM
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: MULTI SUPPORTED was established over 4 axis probes. Re-measured over 8 probes without multistart: nonlinearity index 0.0715047 (unchanged; the maximum lies on an axis), minimum chi-square rise 3.75363, no reason added. The committed refits' chi-square values are not below the estimate's, so the lower-objective rule would not fire on them, but the refits were not re-run.

rules_changed.rule: predictive probes along axes, pairwise diagonals and Sigma grad g per prediction
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: C2 predictive SUPPORTED was established over axis probes only; re-measured (see HUQ-11).

rules_changed.rule: predictive nonlinearity scaled by parameter sd, not total sd
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: C2 nonlinearity was 0.036 total sd; re-measured 0.05658 parameter sd, below the 0.10 downgrade threshold.

rules_changed.rule: a multistart below max(6, 2p + 2) starts caps the claim at DOWNGRADED
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: the script's policy is 6 starts at p = 2, exactly the minimum (max_evaluations=400 is not part of it; 2 of the 6 committed refits failed, so more than half converged), so no downgrade is projected.

rules_changed.rule: a log coordinate's identifiability width is its natural-scale relative width
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: k0_declared_log: the ln k0 width is now exp(q sd) - exp(-q sd) ~ 0.645 instead of 2 q sd / |ln k0| ~ 0.030; the status stays PARAMETERS_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE (condition number and correlation both exceed their thresholds).
MULTI_v2.route.record_digest and every embedded record's digest no longer reproduce (with HUQ-01's policy keys in thresholds).

unchanged: the MULTI estimate and standard deviations (identical when re-derived without multistart), covariance, determinant and correlation, identifiability statuses (declared NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, aligned WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE), the C2 predictive parameter and total sd, the reference grids (Core V1, unaffected), the CORRECTED errata quantities, WEAK_C2 REFUSED (NO_RESIDUAL_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM), and the natural_k0_identity REFUSED / k0_declared_log DOWNGRADED parameterization verdicts.

MULTI_v2.label: PROJECTED (Jacobian, probes, identifiability and C2 predictive MEASURED without multistart; refits not re-run)

WEAK_C2_v2.label: RULE (structural refusal before any probe or multistart)

why_not_regenerated: the MULTI multistart alone is ~76 min of CSTR solves (committed route wall time 4558 s); this stream must never run the K2 multistart. Its frozen bytes are left untouched.
stage_cache_trap: kinetics.py caches stages in D:/v2_k2_cache; stage1/2/5 cached there hold records built under the old rules. The V2-route stages are now cached under *_audit_hybrid names, so a rerun recomputes them instead of restating the old records.
how_to_regenerate: python -X utf8 benchmarks/core_v2_hybrid_uq/audit/kinetics.py (V1 reference-grid stages 3a/3b may be reused from the cache).
